seo.title: Dr. Arvinder Walia | Adult Psychiatrist in Austin, TX
seo.description: Meet Dr. Arvinder Walia, a board-certified adult psychiatrist with expertise in mood, anxiety, cognitive, forensic, and consultation-liaison psychiatry.

providers.specialty: Adult Psychiatry, Mood, Anxiety & Cognitive Disorders
providers.tagline: Experienced psychiatric care for adults, with focused expertise in mood, anxiety, cognitive, forensic, and medically complex concerns.
bioParagraphs: Dr. Arvinder Walia is a board-certified adult psychiatrist in private practice in Austin. His primary areas of interest include mood, anxiety, and cognitive disorders, with additional experience in forensic psychiatric evaluations of healthcare professionals and consultation-liaison psychiatry for metabolic disorders.

Dr. Walia is co-founder and medical director of the Austin Center for Psychological Care, a dialectical behavior intensive outpatient program for personality and mood disorders. He also contributes to the education of Advanced Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner students at the University of Texas at Austin School of Nursing.

residency: Austin Medical Education Program for Psychiatry

hospitalAffiliations: St. David's North Austin Medical Center
academicAppointments: University of Texas at Austin School of Nursing

seo.title: Kathleen Nguyen, PA-C | Northwest Psychiatry Austin
seo.description: Meet Kathleen Nguyen, a board-certified physician assistant providing adult psychiatric care, medication management, education, and individualized treatment planning.

providers.tagline: Compassionate, evidence-based care centered on thoughtful medication management, education, shared decisions, and each patient's goals.
bioParagraphs: Kathleen Nguyen, PA-C, is a board-certified physician assistant with clinical experience in urgent care, post-acute care, and skilled nursing settings. She has cared for adults with a broad range of medical and mental health concerns.

She earned a Master of Science in Physician Assistant studies from the University of Bridgeport and a Bachelor of Science in Biology/Biological Sciences from UC Irvine. Her psychiatric work includes depression, anxiety, mood disorders, insomnia, and behavioral symptoms associated with chronic medical illness.
conditions: Behavioral Symptoms Related to Chronic Illness

seo.title: Khyati Delada, MPAM, PA-C, CNIM | Northwest Psychiatry
seo.description: Meet Khyati Delada, a board-certified physician associate providing adult psychiatric care informed by neuropsychology, neuroscience, behavioral health, and neurology.

providers.tagline: Evidence-based adult psychiatric care informed by experience in neuropsychology, neuroscience, behavioral health, and neurology.
bioParagraphs: Khyati Delada, MPAM, PA-C, CNIM, is a board-certified physician associate with experience in psychiatry, neuropsychology, behavioral health, and neurology. She evaluates and treats adults with depression, anxiety disorders, ADHD, bipolar disorder, insomnia, trauma-related disorders, and other mood and stress-related concerns.

She earned a Master of Science in Physician Assistant studies from the University of Lynchburg and a Bachelor of Science in Neuroscience from the University of Illinois Chicago. She holds PA-C certification through the NCCPA and CNIM certification through ABRET. Her approach emphasizes medication management, education, shared decision-making, and individualized treatment planning.

insurance.headline: Insurance Coverage

insurance.disclaimer: Coverage and benefits are determined by your insurance plan. Listing a carrier does not guarantee coverage for a specific service.

faqs.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: Use the online scheduling link to book a new-patient or follow-up appointment, or call the office at (512) 342-7979 for help.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: Northwest Psychiatry lists Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, Beacon Health Options, UnitedHealthcare, Medicare, and Baylor Scott & White. Participation varies by provider and plan, so please call the office to verify coverage before your visit.

faqs.question: What should I complete before my first visit?
faqs.answer: Complete the new-patient forms before your appointment and arrive 15 minutes early if you are bringing printed paperwork. The practice notes that the forms may take at least 45 minutes to complete.

faqs.question: How do I access the patient portal?
faqs.answer: Use the Patient Portal link to open Northwest Psychiatry's Athenahealth portal for established-patient access.

faqs.question: Are Friday appointments available in the office?
faqs.answer: The current office schedule lists Friday hours from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM for telehealth appointments and phone support, with no in-office appointments.
